card.name: Linking words in repeated label phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking tokens in fixed label phrases, mainly 'for' in 'as well as for other indications' after antidepressant mania warnings. Also the hyphen in trial names like CAPItello-291.

modes.label: as well as for
